title: great spoon, frustrating sticker
text:
great spoon, frustrating sticker. I love this spoon. The size, weight, durability, shape are great & it cleans right up. I want to order more as serving spoons.
I hate the stickers they attach to the bowl. It’s impossible to get them off without using chemicals. So frustrating and there is no need for these stickers. For that reason, I will look for a different vendor to buy more.
